meaning:
1) something cut, furrow, cutting
1a) a furrow
1b) cuttings (as a sign of mourning)
Also means: ge.du.dah (גְּדוּדָה "furrow" H1418)

elsewhere.note: You drench its furrows. You level its ridges. You soften it with showers. You bless it with a crop.
For every head is bald, and every beard clipped. There are cuttings on all the hands, and sackcloth on the waist.
